definition_zh: 农业；农学；耕作；农业体系
definition_en: the practice or science of farming, including growing crops and raising animals
core_image: 犁铧翻开的泥土，一垄一垄伸向天边
scene: 清晨的田里，拖拉机沿着垄沟缓慢前行，翻起湿润的泥土。Agriculture still employs most families in the valley.
sceneCN: 这里 agriculture 是「农业」（第 1 个义项：种植作物与饲养牲畜的生产活动）；句意为在这个山谷里，农业仍然养活着大多数家庭。图中可辨识物件：拖拉机、垄沟、泥土。

pos.zh: 名词：农业；农学；耕作

forms.label: 不可数名词（通常无复数）

derivatives.zh: 由 agriculture 加 -al 构成，义为「农业的；农艺的」
由 agriculture 加 -ist 构成，义为「农学家；农业经营者」
由 agri- 加 business 构成，义为「农业综合企业」

senses.title: Farming as a practice
senses.definition: the work and practice of growing crops and raising animals for food and materials
senses.definitionCN: 种植作物、饲养牲畜以获取食物与材料的工作与生产活动
senses.example: Agriculture still employs most families in the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个山谷里，农业仍然养活着大多数家庭。
senses.why: Latin ager meant a field and cultura meant cultivation; agriculture is literally the cultivating of fields.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ager 意为「田地」，cultura 意为「耕作」；agriculture 字面就是「耕作田地」。

senses.title: The science of farming
senses.definition: the scientific study of farming, including soils, crops, and animal husbandry
senses.definitionCN: 研究耕作、土壤、作物与畜牧的科学
senses.example: She studied agriculture at the provincial university.
senses.exampleCN: 她在省立大学学习农学。
senses.why: The word covers both the work and the study of it, since a science of fields grew out of the fields themselves.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既指劳作，也指对劳作的研究，因为田地的科学本就是从田地里长出来的。

senses.title: A particular way of farming
senses.definition: a specific method or system of cultivating land, such as hillside or dry-land farming
senses.definitionCN: 某种具体的土地利用与耕作方式，如坡地农业或旱地农业
senses.example: Hillside agriculture requires careful terracing.
senses.exampleCN: 坡地耕作需要精心修筑梯田。
senses.why: When fields differ, the cultivating of them differs too; the word names each such way of working the land.
senses.whyCN: 田地不同，耕作方式也就不同；这个词用来指每一种具体的土地利用方式。

senses.title: A region's farming system
senses.definition: the whole farming economy of a region, including its crops, livestock, and trade
senses.definitionCN: 某一地区整体的农业经济，包括作物、牲畜与贸易
senses.example: The island's agriculture depends on steady rainfall.
senses.exampleCN: 这个岛的农业依赖稳定的降雨。
senses.why: A whole region can be seen as one great field, and its farming as one system.
senses.whyCN: 整个地区可以被看作一大片田，而它的农业就是一个体系。

senses.title: The farming sector
senses.definition: the farming industry and the institutions and people concerned with it
senses.definitionCN: 农业产业以及与之相关的机构与人员
senses.example: The ministry of agriculture published its annual report.
senses.exampleCN: 农业部发布了年度报告。
senses.why: Modern states treat farming as a sector with ministries and policies, and the word follows it there.
senses.whyCN: 现代国家把农业当作一个有部委、有政策的部门，这个词也随之进入那个语境。

intro.en: Agriculture joins the Latin words for field and for cultivation.
intro.cn: agriculture 把拉丁语中表示「田地」与「耕作」的两个词连在一起。

items.en: Ager meant a field or a piece of land, and it also gave English acre and agrarian.
items.cn: ager 意为「田地、一块土地」，也生出英语的 acre 与 agrarian。

items.en: Cultura meant tilling, tending, and later care or cultivation of the mind.
items.cn: cultura 意为「耕作、照料」，后来又指心智的培养。

items.en: The compound agricultura named the tilling of fields as a whole occupation.
items.cn: 复合词 agricultura 把耕作田地作为一整套职业来命名。

items.en: English borrowed agriculture for both the work and the skill of farming.
items.cn: 英语借入 agriculture，兼指农耕的劳作与技艺。

items.en: The word widened to the science of farming and to the farming sector of an economy.
items.cn: 词义扩展到农学，以及一个经济体中的农业部门。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built from agri- and -culture; the near-meaning group gathers kinds of farming.
note.cn: 形近组收由 agri- 与 -culture 构成的词；近义组收不同类型的农牧经营。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning relating to farming or the countryside.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「农业的；农艺的」，指与耕作或乡村有关。

entries.definition: A person who practices or studies farming.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农学家；农业经营者」，指从事或研究农业的人。

entries.definition: The commercial side of farming, including supply, processing and trade.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农业综合企业」，指农业的供应、加工与贸易等商业环节。

entries.definition: The activity of growing crops or raising animals on a farm.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「务农；耕作」，指在农场种植作物或饲养牲畜。

entries.definition: The careful management of land, crops, or animals.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农牧管理」，指对土地、作物或牲畜的精心经营。

entries.definition: The act of preparing land and growing crops on it.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「耕作；栽培」，指整地并种植作物的行为。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the word to a field, a plough and the culture of tending land.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几个记忆钩子把这个词与田地、犁铧以及照料土地的「文化」联系起来。

normal.en: AGRI means field: agri + culture is the culture of fields.
normal.cn: agri 意为「田地」：agri 加 culture，就是田地的耕耘之道。

normal.en: Picture a plough turning dark soil into long furrows.
normal.cn: 想象犁铧把深色泥土翻成一道道长沟。

normal.en: Agriculture and culture share a word: both are about tending and growing.
normal.cn: agriculture 与 culture 共用一个词根：两者都关乎照料与生长。

normal.en: Agri appears in acre and agrarian too, all pointing to land.
normal.cn: agri 也出现在 acre 与 agrarian 里，都指向土地。

normal.en: A country's agriculture is its fields plus its farmers plus its markets.
normal.cn: 一个国家的农业，就是它的田地、农民与市场之和。

abstract.en: Agriculture is culture applied to the ground.
abstract.cn: 农业，就是施加在土地上的「文化」。

abstract.en: Every field is a promise that next season will come.
abstract.cn: 每一块田，都是对下一季仍会到来的承诺。

abstract.en: The word treats soil, animals and science as one enterprise.
abstract.cn: 这个词把土壤、牲畜与科学当作同一项事业。

examples.en: Agriculture uses nearly half of the country's fresh water.
examples.cn: 农业用掉了这个国家近一半的淡水。

examples.en: She studied agriculture at the provincial university.
examples.cn: 她在省立大学学习农学。

examples.en: Hillside agriculture requires careful terracing.
examples.cn: 坡地耕作需要精心修筑梯田。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「阿哥，犁，靠它」：阿哥说，犁地靠它，农业就是靠土地吃饭。

root: 拉丁语 ager（田地）与 cultura（耕作）合成 agricultura，字面即「耕作田地」，经法语进入英语，兼指农耕活动、农学与农业部门。

sensesIntro.en: The word covers farming itself, the science of farming, particular methods, a region's farming system and the farming sector.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词覆盖农耕本身、农学、具体耕作法、地区农业体系以及农业部门。

branches.en: the daily work of farming
the study of farming
a particular way of working land
a whole region's farming
farming as an industry

intro.en: Agriculture combines two Latin bases, agri- for field and -culture for tending, and each base forms many words.
intro.cn: agriculture 由两个拉丁词基合成：agri- 表「田地」，-culture 表「照料」，每个词基都能构成许多词。

latinIntro.en: Ager and cultura are the Latin sources; English adds -al, -ist and combines agri- with business words.
latinIntro.cn: ager 与 cultura 是拉丁语来源；英语加上 -al、-ist，并把 agri- 与商业类词组合。

items.example: Agricultural exports rose last year.
items.exampleCN: 去年农产品出口上升了。

items.example: The region is agriculturally rich.
items.exampleCN: 这个地区农业资源丰富。

items.meaning: one who farms or studies farming
items.example: The agriculturist tested three new seeds.
items.exampleCN: 这位农学家试种了三种新种子。

items.example: Agribusiness dominates the local economy.
items.exampleCN: 农业综合企业主导了当地经济。

items.meaningCN: 农用工业；农产品加工业
items.example: The agro-industry employs many villagers.
items.exampleCN: 农产品加工业雇用许多村民。

items.example: Agroforestry protects the thin hillside soil.
items.exampleCN: 农林复合经营保护了稀薄的山坡土壤。

items.example: The law limits several agrochemicals.
items.exampleCN: 法律限制了几种农用化学品。

items.meaning: tourism based on farm stays and rural life
items.example: Agrotourism brings extra income to farms.
items.exampleCN: 农业旅游为农场带来额外收入。

definition_zh: 在前面；向前；提前；领先；在未来
definition_en: in front of someone or something, forward in space or time, or in a leading position
core_image: 视线前方那条还没有走到的路
scene: 山路上，向导指着远处雾气中的村屋，示意大家继续往前走。The path ahead was steep but clear.
sceneCN: 这里 ahead 是「在前面」（第 1 个义项：位于前方的空间位置）；句意为前方的路虽然陡，却清晰可见。图中可辨识物件：山路、雾气、远处的村屋。

pos.zh: 副词：在前面；向前；提前；领先

derivatives.zh: 由 go 加 ahead 构成的复合词，义为「许可；放行」，也可作形容词「积极的」
由 look 加 ahead 构成的复合词，义为「前瞻；预先计算」

senses.title: In front in space
senses.definition: at a position in front of someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 处于某人或某物前方的位置
senses.example: The path ahead was steep but clear.
senses.exampleCN: 前方的路虽然陡，却清晰可见。
senses.why: Ahead is 'on the head': the place directly before one's face, the first stretch of road one can see.
senses.whyCN: ahead 本作「在头上」：正对脸面的那处地方，也就是眼前第一段看得见的路。

senses.title: Forward in movement
senses.definition: moving or pointing forward, away from the present position
senses.definitionCN: 朝前移动或指向，离开当前的位置
senses.example: The hikers walked ahead without waiting for the map.
senses.exampleCN: 徒步者没等地图就继续向前走了。
senses.why: What lies before the head is also the direction of travel; position becomes motion.
senses.whyCN: 位于头前方的，也是行进的方向；位置于是变成了运动。

senses.title: Earlier in time
senses.definition: before the planned or expected time
senses.definitionCN: 在计划或预期的时间之前
senses.example: The meeting was moved ahead by two days.
senses.exampleCN: 会议被提前了两天。
senses.why: The future is pictured as a road in front; to move something ahead is to bring it nearer on that road.
senses.whyCN: 未来被想象成前方的一条路；把某事提前，就是在这条路上把它挪近。

senses.title: In a leading position
senses.definition: in front of competitors in a race, contest, or ranking
senses.definitionCN: 在比赛、竞争或排名中处于对手之前
senses.example: Our team is two goals ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 我们队领先两球。
senses.why: On the road of a contest, whoever is further along the road is ahead.
senses.whyCN: 在竞赛这条路上，谁走得更远，谁就领先。

senses.title: In the future
senses.definition: in the time still to come
senses.definitionCN: 在尚未到来的时间里
senses.example: There are difficult weeks ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 今后还有艰难的几周。
senses.why: Time is read as space: the unvisited future lies before us like an unwalked road.
senses.whyCN: 时间被读作空间：未到访的未来像一条没走过的路，摊在我们面前。

intro.en: Ahead began as a nautical phrase meaning 'on the head', directly before a ship's bow.
intro.cn: ahead 最初是航海用语，意为「在船头」，即正对船首的前方。

items.en: Heafod meant the head, the part of the body that faces forward.
items.cn: heafod 意为「头」，即身体朝前的那一部分。

items.en: Sailors said a ship was on the head when it lay directly before another ship's bow.
items.cn: 水手说某船 on the head，是指它正位于另一艘船船首的前方。

items.en: The phrase a- (from on) plus head was written together as ahead.
items.cn: 短语 a-（来自 on）加 head 被连写成一个词 ahead。

items.en: The word left the sea and came to mean in front, forward, and earlier in time.
items.cn: 这个词离开海洋，开始表示「在前方、向前、提前」。

items.en: Figurative uses widened it further: ahead in a race, ahead in the future.
items.cn: 比喻用法进一步扩展：比赛中领先，以及在未来的前方。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers head-related words; the near-meaning group gathers words of forward direction.
note.cn: 形近组收与 head 相关的词；近义组收表示向前方向的词。

entries.definition: The top part of the body, or the front or leading part of something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「头；前端；首领」，是 ahead 的构成成分。

entries.definition: The title at the top of a page or section.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「标题；题目」，指页面或章节顶端的字样。

entries.definition: Progress made against difficulty.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「进展」，指在困难中取得的推进。

entries.definition: Toward the front or into a further position.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「向前」，指朝前方或更远的位置。

entries.definition: Continuing forward in space or time.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「向前；继续」，指在空间或时间上持续前行。

entries.definition: At a position before someone or something.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「在前面」，指处于某人或某物之前的位置。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the word to a ship's bow, a road before the eyes and a race already led.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几个记忆钩子把这个词与船首、眼前的路以及已经领先的比赛联系起来。

normal.en: AHEAD is a + head: the place in front of your head.
normal.cn: ahead 就是 a 加 head：你脑袋正前方的那个地方。

normal.en: Picture standing at a ship's bow, looking at the water before you.
normal.cn: 想象站在船首，望着眼前的水面。

normal.en: Go ahead means 'move to the front', and also 'you may begin'.
normal.cn: go ahead 既指「走到前面」，也指「你请便、开始吧」。

normal.en: Ahead of time: the road of time has a front end too.
normal.cn: ahead of time 这个说法里，时间这条路也有前端。

normal.en: Two goals ahead: the scoreboard places your team further along the road.
normal.cn: 领先两球：记分牌把你的球队放在了这条路上更远的位置。

abstract.en: Ahead is the shape the future takes when we stand still.
abstract.cn: 当我们站着不动时，未来呈现的形状就是 ahead。

abstract.en: The word turns the body's front into the world's forward.
abstract.cn: 这个词把身体的前方变成了世界的前方。

abstract.en: To lead is simply to be further ahead on the same road.
abstract.cn: 领先，不过是在同一条路上走得更远一点。

examples.en: The path ahead was steep but clear.
examples.cn: 前方的路虽然陡，却清晰可见。

examples.en: The meeting was moved ahead by two days.
examples.cn: 会议被提前了两天。

examples.en: Our team is two goals ahead.
examples.cn: 我们队领先两球。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「啊，黑得」：啊，黑得看不见，还得硬着头皮往前走。

root: 由 a-（即 on）加 head 构成，最初是航海说法「在船头、正对船首」，后泛指「在前方、向前」，再引申为「提前、领先、在未来」。

sensesIntro.en: The word moves from position in front, through forward motion, to earlier time, leading positions and the future.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从前方位置出发，经向前运动，走到提前、领先以及未来。

branches.en: a place before the eyes
movement toward the front
time pulled forward
a contestant further along
the unwalked future

intro.en: Ahead works mostly in fixed phrases and compounds, which is how an adverb of place builds its 'family'.
intro.cn: ahead 主要出现在固定短语与复合词中，一个方位副词就是这样组成自己的「词族」。

latinIntro.en: Ahead is native English from on plus head, so it has no Latin family; this list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: ahead 是 on 加 head 构成的英语本族语词，没有拉丁语同族词，因此这一项留空。

items.meaning: to proceed, or to give permission
items.example: Go ahead and open the letter.
items.exampleCN: 你尽管打开那封信吧。

items.meaning: permission to proceed, or an energetic person
items.example: The council gave the go-ahead for the bridge.
items.exampleCN: 议会批准了建桥计划。

items.meaning: in front of, or earlier than
items.example: She finished ahead of everyone else.
items.exampleCN: 她比其他人先完成。

items.example: Farmers must look ahead to the dry season.
items.exampleCN: 农民必须为旱季早做打算。

items.example: The station is straight ahead.
items.exampleCN: 车站就在正前方。

items.meaning: to arrange things before they are needed
items.example: Plan ahead if you travel in August.
items.exampleCN: 如果八月出行，要提前计划。

items.meaning: to keep moving forward with force
items.example: The team forged ahead despite the rain.
items.exampleCN: 尽管下雨，队伍仍奋力前行。

items.meaning: a calculation or plan made for what comes next
items.example: The program uses look-ahead to avoid delays.
items.exampleCN: 这个程序用前瞻计算来避免延迟。

definition_zh: 帮助；援助；救助；辅助物；助手
definition_en: help or support given to a person or group in need, or something that makes a task easier
core_image: 一只伸向困境的手，把独自扛不动的重负分担下来
scene: 暴雨冲垮了山道，救援队在夜里赶到。The volunteers brought aid to the stranded villagers before dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 aid 是「援助、救助」（第 1 个义项：对身处困境者提供的帮助）；句意为志愿者在天亮前把援助送到被困的村民手中。图中可辨识物件：手电、物资箱、泥泞的山道。

pos.zh: 名词：帮助；援助；辅助物；助手
动词：帮助；援助；有助于

derivatives.zh: 由 un- 加 aided 构成，义为「无援助的；独立的」
由 aid 加 -ed 构成，义为「有辅助的；借助……的」
由 aid 加 -less 构成，义为「无助的；缺乏援助的」

senses.title: Help given to someone in need
senses.definition: help, support, or relief given to a person or group facing danger, illness, or hardship
senses.definitionCN: 给予面临危险、疾病或困苦的个人或群体的帮助、支持或救济
senses.example: The refugees waited for aid at the border crossing.
senses.exampleCN: 难民们在边境口岸等待援助。
senses.why: The core image is a hand reaching toward someone who cannot manage alone; aid is that reaching made visible.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是一只伸向独自应付不了的人的手；aid 就是这只伸出的手被看见的样子。

senses.title: Something that makes a task easier
senses.definition: a tool, device, or resource that helps someone perform a task more easily
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人更轻松完成任务的工具、设备或资源
senses.example: The teacher used a picture card as a visual aid.
senses.exampleCN: 老师用一张图片卡作为视觉教具。
senses.why: Help can be stored in an object: a map, a card, or a machine carries assistance the way a hand does.
senses.whyCN: 帮助可以凝结在物件里：地图、卡片或机器像一只手那样承载着协助。

senses.title: To help or assist
senses.definition: to help or assist a person, group, or effort, especially in a practical way
senses.definitionCN: 帮助或协助某人、某个群体或某项事业，尤指以切实的方式
senses.example: Neighbours aided the family after the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 火灾之后，邻居们帮助了这家人。
senses.why: The verb turns the reaching hand into an action: someone actively lends strength.
senses.whyCN: 动词把伸出的手变成动作：有人主动把自己的力量借出去。

senses.title: To promote or make possible
senses.definition: to promote, support, or make a process easier without directly doing it
senses.definitionCN: 促进、支持或使某个过程更顺利，而不直接去做这件事
senses.example: Clean ventilation aids recovery in crowded wards.
senses.exampleCN: 通风良好有助于拥挤病房里的病人康复。
senses.why: Aid widens from personal help to impersonal conditions that let something succeed.
senses.whyCN: aid 从对人的帮助扩展到非人的条件：这些条件让某件事得以成功。

senses.title: Organized assistance: money, supplies, or troops
senses.titleCN: 有组织的援助：资金、物资或部队
senses.definition: material or military assistance organized by a government, charity, or international body
senses.definitionCN: 由政府、慈善机构或国际组织组织的物资或军事援助
senses.example: The country sent emergency aid after the earthquake.
senses.exampleCN: 地震后这个国家送去了紧急援助。
senses.why: When many hands act together, aid becomes an institution with budgets, ships, and planes.
senses.whyCN: 当许多只手一起行动时，aid 就变成一种有预算、有船只和飞机的制度。

intro.en: Aid comes from Latin through Old French, and its whole family grew from one verb meaning to help.
intro.cn: aid 经由古法语来自拉丁语，整个词族都从一个表示「帮助」的动词生长出来。

items.en: The verb adiuvare meant to help, support, or lend strength to someone, built from ad- toward plus iuvare to help.
items.cn: 动词 adiuvare 意为「帮助、支持、给某人力量」，由 ad-「朝向」加 iuvare「帮助」构成。

items.en: A frequentative form adiutare, meaning to help repeatedly, supplied the stem that Old French later reshaped.
items.cn: 反复体形式 adiutare 表示「反复帮助」，提供了后来被古法语改造的词干。

items.en: Old French had the verb aidier and the noun aide, both carrying the everyday sense of giving help.
items.cn: 古法语有动词 aidier 与名词 aide，两者都带着「给予帮助」的日常含义。

items.en: The noun is recorded in English in the thirteenth century, and the verb followed soon after. Exact first dates are uncertain.
items.cn: 名词在十三世纪出现于英语记录，动词紧随其后。确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: First aid, foreign aid, and teaching aid show how far the word has spread from one hand to whole institutions.
items.cn: first aid、foreign aid 与 teaching aid 显示出这个词从一只手扩展到整套制度。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the same sound and stem; the near-meaning group gathers everyday verbs of helping with different strength.
note.cn: 形近组收同音同词干的形式；近义组收日常表示「帮助」的动词，力度各不相同。

entries.definition: A noun for a person who assists a senior official or commander.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指协助高级官员或指挥官的助手。

entries.definition: The past tense and participial adjective of aid, meaning helped.
entries.definitionCN: aid 的过去式与分词形容词，义为「得到帮助的」。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning done without any help.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「在没有帮助的情况下完成的」。

entries.definition: To make it easier for someone to do something by offering what they lack.
entries.definitionCN: 通过提供对方缺少的东西，使其做事更容易。

entries.definition: To give support to someone who is doing a task, often in a secondary role.
entries.definitionCN: 在某人执行任务时给予支持，常处于辅助位置。

entries.definition: To hold someone or something up, financially, emotionally, or physically.
entries.definitionCN: 在经济、情感或体力上支撑某人或某物。

normalIntro.en: Aid is a short word for a moment that is also short, and these hooks keep it tied to that moment.
normalIntro.cn: aid 是个短词，需要帮助的时刻也很短，下面这些钩子把它牢牢系在那个时刻上。

normal.en: AID is three letters that spell a hand reaching out: A for a person, I for the need, D for the deed.
normal.cn: AID 三个字母像一只伸出的手：A 是人，I 是需求，D 是行动。

normal.en: First aid is the first help given, which makes the phrase easy to recall.
normal.cn: 急救（first aid）是第一时间给出的帮助，这个短语因此好记。

normal.en: An aid worker carries boxes, so picture aid as a box handed over.
normal.cn: 援助工作者搬运箱子，所以把 aid 想成一只递过去的箱子。

normal.en: Aid rhymes with made: help is something made available to someone.
normal.cn: aid 与 made 押韵：帮助是被做出来提供给别人的东西。

normal.en: A hearing aid is a small device, and the word aid fits it exactly.
normal.cn: 助听器（hearing aid）是个小装置，aid 这个词正好贴合它。

abstract.en: Aid is a bridge: it spans the distance between a need and the means to meet it.
abstract.cn: aid 是一座桥：横跨在需求与满足需求的手段之间。

abstract.en: Every act of aid moves something across a gap, whether strength, money, or knowledge.
abstract.cn: 每一次援助都在把某样东西运过缺口，可能是力量、金钱或知识。

abstract.en: Aid implies two sides: one lacks, the other has, and the transfer is the word itself.
abstract.cn: aid 隐含双方：一方缺乏，另一方拥有，而转移这件事就是这个词本身。

examples.en: The clinic received aid from a nearby town.
examples.cn: 诊所收到了邻镇的援助。

examples.en: A walking stick aids balance on rough ground.
examples.cn: 手杖有助于在不平的地面上保持平衡。

examples.en: She came to his aid without being asked.
examples.cn: 她没等开口就来帮他。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「爱德」：有爱心、有德行的人及时伸出援手，这就是援助。

root: 拉丁语 adiuvare（帮助）经古法语 aidier 进入英语；ad- 表示「朝向」，iuvare 表示「帮助」，合起来就是「向某人伸出援手」。

sensesIntro.en: Aid ranges from the hand that helps, to the object that helps, to the verb of helping, to the organized flow of money and supplies.
sensesIntro.cn: aid 从伸出的手，到起辅助作用的物件，再到帮助的动词，最后到有组织的资金与物资流动。

core.en: A hand reaching toward someone who cannot carry the load alone.
core.cn: 一只伸向独自扛不动重负者的手。

branches.en: Help offered to a person or group in danger or hardship.
branches.cn: 向处于危险或困苦中的个人或群体提供的帮助。

branches.en: A concrete object that carries help, such as a teaching aid.
branches.cn: 承载帮助的具体物件，例如教具。

branches.en: The verb of helping or assisting someone directly.
branches.cn: 直接帮助或协助某人的动词用法。

branches.en: The widened verb: conditions or measures that let something succeed.
branches.cn: 扩展后的动词用法：让某事得以成功的条件或措施。

branches.en: Organized aid: money, supplies, or forces sent by institutions.
branches.cn: 有组织的援助：由机构送出的资金、物资或部队。

intro.en: Aid is a bare stem that builds compounds freely, and its family is small but productive.
intro.cn: aid 是能自由构成复合词的裸词干，它的词族不大，但构词能力强。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb adiuvare and its frequentative adiutare supply the deeper layer of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语动词 adiuvare 及其反复体 adiutare 构成了这个词族的深层来源。

items.example: They aid the villagers after every flood.
items.exampleCN: 每次洪水过后他们都援助村民。

items.example: The rescue was aided by a clear moon.
items.exampleCN: 救援得到了明亮月光的帮助。

items.meaningCN: 帮助；协助（进行时或动名词）
items.example: She is aiding the new students this term.
items.exampleCN: 这个学期她在帮助新生。

items.example: He finished the climb unaided.
items.exampleCN: 他独自完成了这次攀登。

items.example: The aidless village waited for the convoy.
items.exampleCN: 缺乏援助的村庄等待着车队。

items.example: She gave first aid to the injured cyclist.
items.exampleCN: 她为受伤的骑车人做了急救。

items.meaning: a classroom tool that helps learning
items.example: The map on the wall serves as a teaching aid.
items.exampleCN: 墙上的地图充当教具。

items.meaning: a person who delivers humanitarian aid
items.example: An aid worker opened the supply tent.
items.exampleCN: 一名援助工作者打开了物资帐篷。

items.meaning: to help someone commit a crime
items.example: The court found him guilty of aiding and abetting the fraud.
items.exampleCN: 法庭认定他协助并教唆了这起诈骗。

latinEntries.example: Latin writers used adiuvare when one person lent strength to another.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语作者用 adiuvare 表示一个人把自己的力量借给另一个人。

latinEntries.example: An adiutor stood beside the magistrate.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 一名助手站在长官身旁。

definition_zh: 助手；副官；侍从武官；（政要的）助理
definition_en: a person who assists a senior official, commander, or professional, especially by handling routine tasks
core_image: 紧跟要人身侧、随时递上文件的随身助手
scene: 听证会开始前，助理们把一叠新材料塞进议员手里。A quiet aide whispered the latest figures into the mayor's ear during the hearing.
sceneCN: 这里 aide 是「助理、助手」（第 1 个义项：为要人处理事务的助理人员）；句意为一名安静的助手在听证会期间把最新数字低声告诉市长。

pos.zh: 名词：助手；副官；（政要的）助理

derivatives.zh: 与 aide 同源；aide 是法语借形，专指人，aid 是更早的「帮助」名词与动词
由 aide 与法语 camp 复合而成，义为「副官；侍从武官」

senses.title: A personal assistant to a powerful figure
senses.definition: a person employed to assist a senior official or public figure with routine work, scheduling, and advice
senses.definitionCN: 受雇协助高级官员或公众人物处理日常事务、安排日程并提供意见的人
senses.example: The governor's aide scheduled every meeting for the week.
senses.exampleCN: 州长的助理安排好了这一周的所有会议。
senses.why: The French noun aide meant help, and English narrowed it to the person who stands beside power.
senses.whyCN: 法语名词 aide 意为「帮助」，英语把词义收窄为站在权力身旁的那个人。

senses.title: A military officer attached to a commander
senses.definition: an officer assigned to a senior commander to carry orders, arrange duties, and assist with command
senses.definitionCN: 被派往高级指挥官身边传递命令、安排事务并协助指挥的军官
senses.example: The general's aide delivered the order to the front line.
senses.exampleCN: 将军的副官把命令送到了前线。
senses.why: In armies the helper must also be an officer, so aide took on a precise rank-bound meaning.
senses.whyCN: 在军队里，助手本身也必须是军官，因此 aide 获得了一个与军衔相关的精确含义。

senses.title: An assistant in a hospital, school, or office
senses.titleCN: 医院、学校或办公室的助理
senses.definition: a worker who supports professionals in an institution, such as a nurse's aide or a teacher's aide
senses.definitionCN: 在机构中支持专业人员工作的员工，如护理助理或教师助理
senses.example: A nurse's aide checked the patient's temperature every hour.
senses.exampleCN: 护理助理每小时给病人量一次体温。
senses.why: The word spread from politics and armies to any institution where one person supports another's professional work.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从政治和军队扩展到任何一个人支持另一个人专业工作的机构。

intro.en: Aide is a French loanword whose root is the Latin verb for helping; English kept the human sense.
intro.cn: aide 是法语借词，其根源是拉丁语表示「帮助」的动词；英语保留了「人」这一层含义。

items.en: The frequentative adiutare, to help repeatedly, grew out of adiuvare and passed into French.
items.cn: 反复体 adiutare 表示「反复帮助」，它从 adiuvare 生长出来并传入法语。

items.en: The agent noun adiutor named the helper himself, a person rather than an act.
items.cn: 施事名词 adiutor 指帮助者本人，是人而不是行为。

items.en: Old French aide carried both the abstract sense of help and the concrete sense of a helper at court.
items.cn: 古法语 aide 既带「帮助」的抽象义，也带宫廷中「帮手」的具体义。

items.en: The military phrase aide-de-camp brought the word into English, still tied to a titled position.
items.cn: 军事短语 aide-de-camp 把这个词带入英语，当时仍与一个有头衔的职位绑定。

items.en: In the twentieth century the short aide spread to political staff and institutional assistants of every kind.
items.cn: 二十世纪，短形式 aide 扩展到政治幕僚以及各类机构助理。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms that share the sound of aide; the near-meaning group gathers kinds of assistants with different ranks.
note.cn: 形近组收与 aide 同音的形式；近义组收不同层级的助手类称谓。

entries.definition: The noun and verb for help itself, from which the person-word aide split off.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「帮助」本身的名词与动词，aide 这个指人的词由它分化而来。

entries.definition: The full military phrase from which the short aide was clipped.
entries.definitionCN: 完整的军中使用说法，短形式 aide 是从它截短而来。

entries.definition: The past tense and participial adjective of the verb aid, meaning helped.
entries.definitionCN: 动词 aid 的过去式与分词形容词，义为「得到帮助的」。

entries.definition: A broad word for anyone who helps another person with their work.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指任何协助他人工作的人。

entries.definition: A person whose help consists mainly of giving expert advice.
entries.definitionCN: 帮助主要以提供专业意见为主的人。

entries.definition: A person who acts in place of a superior and can take over their duties.
entries.definitionCN: 代替上级行事、能够接手其职责的人。

normalIntro.en: Aide sounds like aid, and the difference is a person: these hooks keep the human figure in view.
normalIntro.cn: aide 与 aid 同音，差别在于「人」；下面这些钩子让这个人的形象始终留在眼前。

normal.en: Aide and aid sound the same; the final e marks a person rather than the act.
normal.cn: aide 与 aid 同音，词尾的 e 标记的是人，而不是行为。

normal.en: An aide stands beside the boss like a shadow with a notebook.
normal.cn: aide 像带着笔记本的影子一样站在上司身边。

normal.en: Aide-de-camp is the long military version, so the short aide is a clipped uniform word.
normal.cn: 副官（aide-de-camp）是军中的长说法，短形式 aide 像是被裁短的军装词。

normal.en: Think of a nurse's aide: the helping hands closest to the patient.
normal.cn: 想想护理助理：离病人最近的那双帮手。

normal.en: The word ends in e, and the person is always at the elbow of power.
normal.cn: 这个词以 e 结尾，而这个人总是守在权力者的肘边。

abstract.en: An aide converts a leader's limited hours into organized action.
abstract.cn: aide 把领导者有限的时间转化成有组织的行动。

abstract.en: The role is relational: an aide exists only in reference to the person served.
abstract.cn: 这个角色是关系性的：aide 只相对于被服务者而存在。

abstract.en: Aide is proximity institutionalized: closeness itself becomes a job.
abstract.cn: aide 是被制度化的邻近：靠近本身变成了一份工作。

examples.en: The senator's aide drafted the reply before the vote.
examples.cn: 参议员的助理在投票前起草了答复。

examples.en: A military aide carried the sealed orders to the front.
examples.cn: 一名军事副官把密封的命令送到了前线。

examples.en: The new aide learned the office routine in a week.
examples.cn: 新来的助理一周就熟悉了办公室的日常流程。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「挨得」：挨在要人身边、随叫随到的人，就是 aide。

root: aide 借自法语 aide（帮助），与英语 aid 同源；进入英语后词义收窄，专指在要人身边提供帮助的人。

sensesIntro.en: Aide moves from the personal assistant of a powerful figure, to the military officer at a commander's side, to the institutional helper in hospitals and schools.
sensesIntro.cn: aide 从要人的私人助理，到指挥官身边的军官，再到医院与学校里的机构助理。

core.en: A figure standing close to power, ready with papers and information.
core.cn: 一个紧靠权力身侧、随时递上文件与信息的人。

branches.en: The personal assistant who manages a senior figure's schedule and messages.
branches.cn: 管理要人日程与信息的私人助理。

branches.en: The military officer who carries orders at a commander's side.
branches.cn: 在指挥官身边传递命令的军官。

branches.en: The institutional helper who supports nurses, teachers, or office staff.
branches.cn: 在医院、学校或办公室里支持专业人员的助理。

branches.en: Both senses share the same core: one person smoothing another's daily work.
branches.cn: 两个义项共享同一核心：一个人替另一个人理顺日常工作。

branches.en: Both senses add an institution around the helper, military or civilian.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在助手周围加上了机构，或军事或民用。

intro.en: Aide is a French loanword that now works mainly in compounds and fixed titles.
intro.cn: aide 是法语借词，如今主要在复合词与固定头衔中活动。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is the helping verb adiuvare and its agent noun adiutor.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源是表示「帮助」的动词 adiuvare 及其施事名词 adiutor。

items.example: The aide opened the folder.
items.exampleCN: 助理打开了文件夹。

items.example: Two aides waited outside the room.
items.exampleCN: 两名助手等在房间外面。

items.example: The aide-de-camp rode beside the general.
items.exampleCN: 副官骑马走在将军身旁。

items.example: A presidential aide briefed the press.
items.exampleCN: 一名总统助理向媒体做了简报。

items.example: A senior aide handled the negotiation.
items.exampleCN: 一名高级助理负责这次谈判。

items.example: Only a close aide knew the plan.
items.exampleCN: 只有一名亲信助手知道这个计划。

items.meaning: an assistant who has served for years
items.example: His longtime aide knew every contact.
items.exampleCN: 他的长期助手认识每一个联系人。

items.example: The nurse's aide changed the bedding.
items.exampleCN: 护理助理更换了床铺。

items.example: A teacher's aide helped with reading groups.
items.exampleCN: 一名教师助理协助阅读小组。

latinEntries.example: The verb adiutare described steady, repeated help.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 动词 adiutare 描述稳定而反复的帮助。

latinEntries.example: The adiutor carried messages for the governor.

definition_zh: 使苦恼；困扰；使不适；生病
definition_en: to trouble, afflict, or make someone suffer, especially with pain or illness
core_image: 一种说不清的不适，像阴影一样缠住身体或心事
scene: 连续几周，老人吃得很少，也不愿出门。Something seemed to ail him, though no doctor could name it.
sceneCN: 这里 ail 是「使不适、困扰」（第 1 个义项：使身体或精神感到不适）；句意为似乎有什么在折磨他，可医生都说不出病名。

pos.zh: 动词：使苦恼；困扰；使不适；生病

collocations.zh: 你哪里不舒服；你怎么了

derivatives.zh: 由 ail 加 -ment 构成，义为「小病；不适」
由 ail 加 -ing 构成，义为「生病的；衰弱的；不景气的」

senses.title: To trouble or afflict someone
senses.definition: to cause trouble, worry, or discomfort to a person, often without a clear cause
senses.definitionCN: 给某人带来麻烦、忧虑或不适，常无明显原因
senses.example: Something seemed to ail him, though no doctor could name it.
senses.exampleCN: 似乎有什么在折磨他，可医生都说不出病名。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply to weigh on someone: an unseen trouble settles over a person and will not lift.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「压在某人身上」：一种看不见的麻烦罩住一个人，迟迟不肯散去。

senses.title: To be unwell
senses.definition: to be ill or in poor health, used chiefly in literary or older English
senses.definitionCN: 生病或健康不佳，主要用于书面语或较早的英语
senses.example: She has been ailing since the early spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她从初春起就一直身体不适。
senses.why: The trouble moves inside the body: the person is no longer the one afflicting, but the one who suffers.
senses.whyCN: 困扰转移到身体内部：人不再是施加折磨的一方，而成了承受折磨的一方。

senses.title: To be the matter with, in questions
senses.titleCN: （疑问句中）使……不舒服；是……的毛病
senses.definition: to be the cause of someone's trouble, used mainly in questions such as what ails you
senses.definitionCN: 成为某人不适的原因，主要用于 what ails you 这类疑问句
senses.example: The nurse asked gently what ailed the child.
senses.exampleCN: 护士轻声问孩子哪里不舒服。
senses.why: A question turns the verb into a search: the speaker asks an unseen trouble to name itself.
senses.whyCN: 疑问句把这个动词变成一次寻找：说话者让那个看不见的麻烦自己报出名字。

senses.title: Archaic: to pain or distress
senses.definition: in older usage, to cause physical pain or emotional distress to someone
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的用法中，指给某人造成身体疼痛或情绪痛苦
senses.example: Grief ailed him long after the funeral.
senses.exampleCN: 葬礼过去很久，悲伤仍在折磨他。
senses.why: Before medicine separated body from mind, the same verb could cover a wound and a sorrow alike.
senses.whyCN: 在医学把身体与精神分开之前，同一个动词既能指伤口，也能指悲伤。

intro.en: Ail is a native English verb with Germanic roots, and its older meaning was broader than illness alone.
intro.cn: ail 是带有日耳曼词根的本族英语动词，它较早的含义比「生病」更宽。

items.en: The reconstructed verb meant to trouble or pain, and it left relatives in several Germanic languages.
items.cn: 这个重构动词意为「使烦恼、使痛苦」，在几种日耳曼语言中留下了同源词。

items.en: Old English eglan meant to trouble, plague, or afflict, covering both bodily and mental disturbance.
items.cn: 古英语 eglan 意为「使烦恼、折磨、使痛苦」，兼指身体与精神上的扰动。

items.en: The related adjective egle meant painful or troublesome, showing that the family centred on discomfort.
items.cn: 相关形容词 egle 意为「痛苦的、麻烦的」，说明这个词族围绕「不适」展开。

items.en: In Middle English the verb settled into the form ailen, and illness became its most frequent subject.
items.cn: 在中古英语中，这个动词定型为 ailen，疾病成为它最常见的对象。

items.en: Modern usage keeps the verb mainly in questions and in the adjective ailing, which also describes weak economies.
items.cn: 现代用法主要把动词保留在疑问句中，并常用形容词 ailing，后者也能形容疲弱的经济。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words close in spelling or sound; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of troubling and becoming ill.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写或读音相近的词；近义组收表示「困扰」与「生病」的动词。

entries.definition: A noun for a kind of beer, unrelated in meaning to ail.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指一种啤酒，与 ail 在意义上无关。

entries.definition: A minor illness or disorder, formed from ail with the noun suffix -ment.
entries.definitionCN: 由 ail 加名词后缀 -ment 构成，义为「小病、不适」。

entries.definition: The present participle of ail, used as an adjective for someone or something that is weak.
entries.definitionCN: ail 的现在分词，作形容词指身体衰弱或状况不佳的人或事物。

entries.definition: To cause worry, difficulty, or inconvenience to someone.
entries.definitionCN: 给某人带来忧虑、困难或不便。

entries.definition: To cause suffering or pain to someone over a period of time.
entries.definitionCN: 在一段时间内给某人造成痛苦或折磨。

entries.definition: To become ill, or to make someone feel ill.
entries.definitionCN: 生病，或使某人感到不适。

normalIntro.en: Ail is a small word for a vague kind of suffering, and these hooks keep that vagueness in view.
normalIntro.cn: ail 是个小词，却指向一种说不清的受苦状态；下面这些钩子让这种模糊感留在眼前。

normal.en: Ail sounds like the sigh at the start of a complaint: a long, low ah.
normal.cn: ail 听起来像抱怨开头的那声叹息：低低的一声「唉」。

normal.en: What ails you is a fixed question, so picture a nurse asking it at a bedside.
normal.cn: what ails you 是固定问法，想象护士在病床边问出这句话。

normal.en: The adjective ailing fits both a sick body and a weak economy.
normal.cn: 形容词 ailing 既能形容生病的身体，也能形容疲弱的经济。

normal.en: Ail is short and dull, much like the tiredness it describes.
normal.cn: ail 又短又沉，正像它所描述的那种疲惫。

normal.en: Link ail with ailment: the noun makes the hidden trouble concrete.
normal.cn: 把 ail 与 ailment 联系起来：名词把隐藏的困扰变成具体的病。

abstract.en: Ail describes trouble that has no clear outline, only a weight.
abstract.cn: ail 描述的是没有清晰轮廓、只有重量的困扰。

abstract.en: The word belongs to the sufferer's side: it names what presses down, not what strikes.
abstract.cn: 这个词站在受苦者一侧：它命名的是压下来的东西，而不是打击本身。

abstract.en: To ail is to be out of order quietly, without drama or a named disease.
abstract.cn: ail 是安静地失去正常状态，没有戏剧性，也没有一个被命名的病。

examples.en: A strange tiredness ailed her all winter.
examples.cn: 一种奇怪的疲惫折磨了她整个冬天。

examples.en: The ailing factory closed two production lines.
examples.cn: 这家不景气的工厂关停了两条生产线。

examples.en: He refused to say what ailed him.
examples.cn: 他不肯说自己哪里不舒服。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「哎哟」：身体一出问题就忍不住喊「哎哟」，正是 ail 的困扰感。

root: 古英语 eglan（使苦恼、折磨）演变而来，与表示「痛苦」的 egle 同源；核心是缠住人的不适。

sensesIntro.en: Ail covers trouble that weighs on a person, the state of being unwell, the question of what is wrong, and an older sense of plain pain.
sensesIntro.cn: ail 覆盖压在人与上的困扰、身体不适的状态、询问哪里出了毛病，以及较早的单纯痛苦之义。

core.en: A shadow of discomfort settling over body or mind.
core.cn: 一片落在身体或心上的不适阴影。

branches.en: An unseen trouble weighing on a person.
branches.cn: 一种压在某人身上的看不见的困扰。

branches.en: The same trouble turned inward: the person is simply unwell.
branches.cn: 同一种困扰转向内部：人就是身体不适。

branches.en: The trouble becomes a question, asked to discover its name.
branches.cn: 困扰变成一个疑问，用来找出它的名字。

branches.en: The oldest layer: pain or sorrow, before illness was a separate idea.
branches.cn: 最古老的一层：疼痛或悲伤，当时疾病还不是独立概念。

branches.en: Both senses keep the trouble hidden and ask someone else to identify it.
branches.cn: 两个义项都让困扰保持隐蔽，要靠别人来辨认它。

intro.en: Ail is a native verb with few affixes, but its -ing and -ment forms do most of the modern work.
intro.cn: ail 是本族动词，词缀不多，现代的用法主要靠 -ing 与 -ment 两种形式承担。

latinIntro.en: Ail has no Latin source; it comes from Old English and Germanic roots, so this section is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: ail 没有拉丁语来源，它来自古英语与日耳曼语词根，因此本节留空。

items.example: Nothing seemed to ail the sturdy old dog.
items.exampleCN: 这只结实的老年似乎什么毛病也没有。

items.meaningCN: 使苦恼；生病（第三人称单数）
items.example: What ails the engine is still unknown.
items.exampleCN: 发动机到底出了什么毛病仍不清楚。

items.example: A mild fever ailed him for two days.
items.exampleCN: 低烧折磨了他两天。

items.meaningCN: 生病的；衰弱的；不景气的
items.example: The ailing bridge was closed to traffic.
items.exampleCN: 这座状况不佳的桥禁止通行。

items.example: A common ailment kept her home.
items.exampleCN: 一场常见的小病让她待在家里。

items.meaningCN: 你哪里不舒服；你怎么了
items.example: The doctor asked what ailed you.
items.exampleCN: 医生问你哪里不舒服。

items.example: The ailing economy shed thousands of jobs.
items.exampleCN: 疲弱的经济削减了数千个岗位。

items.example: His ailing health forced an early retirement.
items.exampleCN: 他日渐衰弱的健康迫使他提前退休。

items.example: The ailing industry asked for state support.
items.exampleCN: 不景气的行业请求国家支持。

definition_zh: 目标；目的；瞄准；（用枪等）对准；旨在；致力于
definition_en: a purpose or goal that one intends to achieve, or the act of pointing something toward a target
core_image: 目光与枪口同时指向远处的一点
scene: 训练场上，射手把呼吸压到最慢。She took a long breath, steadied her hand, and aimed at the distant target.
sceneCN: 这里 aim 是「瞄准」（第 3 个义项：把武器或目光对准目标）；句意为她长吸一口气，稳住手，瞄准远处的靶子。

pos.zh: 名词：目标；目的；瞄准
动词：瞄准；对准；旨在；致力于

derivatives.zh: 由 aim 加 -less 构成，义为「无目的的；没有方向的」
由 aimless 加 -ly 构成，义为「漫无目的地」
由 aimless 加 -ness 构成，义为「无目的状态」

senses.title: A purpose or goal
senses.definition: the result or outcome that a person or plan intends to achieve
senses.definitionCN: 个人或计划打算达到的结果或成果
senses.example: The aim of the project is to cut household waste.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目的目标是减少家庭垃圾。
senses.why: An aim is a point chosen in advance: the mind fixes on a result the way a hand fixes on a target.
senses.whyCN: aim 是预先选定的一个点：心锁定某个结果，就像手锁定一个靶子。

senses.title: The act of pointing at a target
senses.definition: the act of directing a weapon, tool, or look toward a chosen point
senses.definitionCN: 把武器、工具或视线对准某个选定位置的动作
senses.example: Her aim was steady despite the strong wind.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管风很大，她的瞄准依然稳定。
senses.why: Here the abstract point becomes physical: the body aligns with a distant mark.
senses.whyCN: 在这里，抽象的点变成物理的点：身体与远处的标记对齐。

senses.title: To point a weapon or object at something
senses.definition: to direct a weapon, camera, or other object toward a target
senses.definitionCN: 把武器、相机或其他物体对准某个目标
senses.example: He aimed the camera at the horizon.
senses.exampleCN: 他把相机对准地平线。
senses.why: The verb applies the physical image: an object is turned until it points where the user wants.
senses.whyCN: 动词把这幅物理画面付诸行动：把物体转到使用者希望它指向的位置。

senses.title: To intend to achieve something
senses.definition: to plan or intend to achieve a particular result or effect
senses.definitionCN: 计划或打算实现某个特定结果或效果
senses.example: The campaign aims to reach young voters.
senses.exampleCN: 这场竞选活动旨在触达年轻选民。
senses.why: The target is no longer a thing but an outcome, and aiming becomes planning.
senses.whyCN: 靶子不再是物件，而是一个结果，瞄准于是变成了规划。

senses.title: To direct words or actions at someone
senses.definition: to direct a remark, criticism, or action toward a particular person or group
senses.definitionCN: 把话语、批评或行动指向某个特定的人或群体
senses.example: The remark was aimed at the new manager.
senses.exampleCN: 这番话是针对新经理说的。
senses.why: Speech can be aimed too: words travel toward a chosen person like an arrow.
senses.whyCN: 话语也能被瞄准：言辞像箭一样飞向选定的那个人。

intro.en: Aim came through Old French from a Latin verb of estimating, and the idea of measuring distance became the idea of pointing.
intro.cn: aim 经古法语来自一个表示「估量」的拉丁语动词，量距离的意思后来变成了「对准」。

items.en: The verb aestimare meant to value, judge, or estimate, including estimating a distance.
items.cn: 动词 aestimare 意为「估价、判断、估量」，其中也包括估量距离。

items.en: Old French aesmer narrowed the sense toward aiming and pointing, while keeping the idea of calculation.
items.cn: 古法语 aesmer 把词义收窄到「瞄准、对准」，同时保留了「计算」的意思。

items.en: The verb entered English in the fourteenth century; the noun followed with the sense of a target or purpose.
items.cn: 动词在十四世纪进入英语；名词随后出现，带有「靶子、目的」的含义。

items.en: By the sixteenth century aim covered both the physical act of pointing and the mental act of intending.
items.cn: 到十六世纪，aim 同时覆盖了物理上的对准与心理上的打算。

items.en: Modern phrases such as aim at, aim for, and aimless keep the image of a chosen point alive.
items.cn: aim at、aim for 与 aimless 等现代短语让「选定一点」的画面继续存活。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on the same stem; the near-meaning group gathers nouns for the point one tries to reach.
note.cn: 形近组收同一词干构成的形式；近义组收表示「想要达到的那一点」的名词。

entries.definition: Without a purpose or direction, formed from aim with -less.
entries.definitionCN: 由 aim 加 -less 构成，义为「没有目的或方向的」。

entries.definition: The present participle of aim, naming the ongoing act of pointing or planning.
entries.definitionCN: aim 的现在分词，指正在进行的对准或规划动作。

entries.definition: The past tense and participle of aim, meaning pointed or intended.
entries.definitionCN: aim 的过去式与过去分词，义为「对准了」或「意在」。

entries.definition: The result that a person or team works toward, often with a clear finish line.
entries.definitionCN: 个人或团队努力追求的结果，常带有明确的终点。

entries.definition: The reason for doing something, or the intention behind an action.
entries.definitionCN: 做某事的原因，或行动背后的意图。

entries.definition: A specific object, figure, or level that one tries to hit or reach.
entries.definitionCN: 试图击中或达到的具体对象、数字或水平。

normalIntro.en: Aim is a word of alignment, and these hooks keep the picture of eye, hand, and distant point aligned.
normalIntro.cn: aim 是一个关于「对齐」的词；下面这些钩子让眼睛、手与远处那一点保持在一条线上。

normal.en: Aim is one syllable, like the single point at which a shooter stares.
normal.cn: aim 只有一个音节，像射手紧盯的那一个点。

normal.en: Take aim: the phrase itself is a short command, easy to remember.
normal.cn: take aim 本身就是一句简短口令，很好记。

normal.en: Aim at and aim for split two uses: hitting a point and reaching a goal.
normal.cn: aim at 与 aim for 分出两种用法：击中一点与达到一个目标。

normal.en: Picture a camera aimed at the horizon: the word covers tools as well as weapons.
normal.cn: 想象把相机对准地平线：这个词不只用于武器，也用于工具。

normal.en: Aimless is aim with -less, a picture of a hand pointing at nothing.
normal.cn: aimless 是 aim 加 -less，画面是一只指向虚无的手。

abstract.en: An aim is a future point made present by attention.
abstract.cn: aim 是通过注意力被拉到当下的一个未来之点。

abstract.en: Aiming is the act of making body, tool, and intention agree on one line.
abstract.cn: 瞄准是让身体、工具与意图在同一条线上达成一致的动作。

abstract.en: Without an aim, effort spreads out; with one, it narrows into a direction.
abstract.cn: 没有 aim，努力会四散；有了 aim，努力就收束成一个方向。

examples.en: Her aim is to finish the report by Friday.
examples.cn: 她的目标是在周五前完成报告。

examples.en: He aimed the telescope at the moon.
examples.cn: 他把望远镜对准月亮。

examples.en: The training aims to improve workplace safety.
examples.cn: 这项培训旨在提升工作场所的安全。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「暗」：暗中盯住的那一点，就是 aim 所指的目标。

root: 经古法语 aesmer（估计、瞄准）来自拉丁语 aestimare（估价、判断）；由「估量距离」引申为「对准目标」。

sensesIntro.en: Aim runs from the goal in the mind, to the physical act of pointing, to the verb of directing weapons, plans, and remarks.
sensesIntro.cn: aim 从心中的目标，到物理上的对准动作，再到指向武器、计划与言辞的动词用法。

core.en: Eye and hand locked onto one distant point.
core.cn: 目光与手同时锁定远处的同一点。

branches.en: The goal that exists first in the mind.
branches.cn: 先存在于心中的那个目标。

branches.en: The physical act of aligning a weapon or look.
branches.cn: 把武器或视线对齐的物理动作。

branches.en: The verb that turns the body toward a target.
branches.cn: 让身体转向目标的动词用法。

branches.en: The verb widened to plans and intended outcomes.
branches.cn: 动词扩展到计划与预期结果的用法。

branches.en: The verb applied to words aimed at a person.
branches.cn: 动词用于指向某人的言辞。

intro.en: Aim is a short free stem; its family grows mainly through -less and through fixed prepositional phrases.
intro.cn: aim 是简短的自由词干；它的词族主要靠 -less 与固定介词短语扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is aestimare, to estimate, which also gave English estimate and esteem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语层是 aestimare（估量），它也给了英语 estimate 与 esteem。

items.example: The aim is clear even if the method is not.
items.exampleCN: 方法虽不明确，目标却很清楚。

items.meaningCN: 目标（复数）；（第三人称单数）瞄准
items.example: The plan aims at a cleaner river.
items.exampleCN: 这项计划旨在让河流更清洁。

items.example: The arrow was aimed at the center.
items.exampleCN: 箭对准了中心。

items.example: She is aiming for a higher score.
items.exampleCN: 她力求拿到更高的分数。

items.example: An aimless walk cleared his head.
items.exampleCN: 一次漫无目的的散步让他头脑清醒。

items.example: They wandered aimlessly through the old town.
items.exampleCN: 他们在老城里漫无目的地游荡。

items.meaning: the state of having no goal
items.example: The aimlessness of the summer unsettled her.
items.exampleCN: 这个夏天的无所事事让她不安。

items.example: The lesson aims at practical skills.
items.exampleCN: 这堂课针对实用技能。

items.example: The guard took aim at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 卫兵瞄准了大门。

latinEntries.example: Roman surveyors used aestimare for measuring distance.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 罗马测量者用 aestimare 表示测量距离。

latinEntries.example: The aestimatio fixed the price of the land.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 这份估价确定了土地的价格。

definition_zh: 空气；大气；空中；神态；播送
definition_en: the invisible mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and that people and animals breathe
core_image: 看不见却托住一切呼吸与飞行的透明介质
scene: 清晨的山谷里，雾气还没散，鸟群已经贴着树梢飞过。The balloon rose slowly into the cool morning air.
sceneCN: 这里 air 是「空气、大气」（第 1 个义项：人呼吸的混合气体）；句意为气球缓缓升入清冷的晨间空气。

pos.zh: 名词：空气；大气；空中；神态
动词：播送；晾晒；使通风

derivatives.zh: 由 air 加 -y 构成，义为「通风的；轻盈的；空洞的」
由 air 加 -less 构成，义为「没有空气的；不通风的」
由 airy 加 -ness 构成，义为「通风；轻盈」

senses.title: The mixture of gases we breathe
senses.definition: the invisible mixture of gases that surrounds the earth and supports life
senses.definitionCN: 包围地球、维持生命、看不见的混合气体
senses.example: The room needs fresh air.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间需要新鲜空气。
senses.why: The core sense is the medium itself: something present everywhere yet never seen.
senses.whyCN: 核心义项就是这种介质本身：无处不在，却从不可见。

senses.title: The open space above the ground
senses.definition: the space above the earth where birds, aircraft, and objects can move
senses.definitionCN: 地面上方、鸟、飞行器和物体可以活动的空间
senses.example: The kite hung in the still air.
senses.exampleCN: 风筝悬在静止的空中。
senses.why: The same invisible medium becomes a stage: whatever rises above ground is up in the air.
senses.whyCN: 同一种看不见的介质变成了舞台：凡升到地面以上的，都在空中。

senses.title: A manner or appearance
senses.definition: a noticeable manner, style, or impression that a person or place gives
senses.definitionCN: 一个人或一个地方给人的明显神态、风格或印象
senses.example: She had an air of confidence.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一种自信的神态。
senses.why: An atmosphere surrounds a room, and a person can surround himself with an impression in the same way.
senses.whyCN: 气氛环绕着一个房间，一个人也能用某种印象把自己环绕起来。

senses.title: To broadcast
senses.definition: to make a program, recording, or message available through radio or television
senses.definitionCN: 通过广播或电视播放节目、录音或信息
senses.example: The show will air next Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 这个节目下周一播出。
senses.why: Sound and pictures travel through the air, so the medium gave its name to the act of sending.
senses.whyCN: 声音与画面通过空气传播，于是介质本身给了「发送」这个动作一个名字。

senses.title: To expose to the air
senses.definition: to expose something to fresh air in order to dry it or remove smells
senses.definitionCN: 把某物暴露在新鲜空气中，使其干燥或去除气味
senses.example: We aired the blankets in the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在太阳下晾晒毯子。
senses.why: The element is used as a tool: letting air move through cloth or a room does the work.
senses.whyCN: 这种元素被当作工具使用：让空气穿过布料或房间，工作就完成了。

intro.en: Air travelled from Greek through Latin and French, and it picked up both a physical and a social sense along the way.
intro.cn: air 从希腊语经拉丁语与法语一路走来，途中同时获得了物理义与社会义。

items.en: The Greek noun aēr named the misty lower atmosphere, the air that people actually breathe.
items.cn: 希腊语名词 aēr 指雾气般的下层大气，也就是人们实际呼吸的空气。

items.en: Latin took the word as aer, using it for air and atmosphere in both prose and poetry.
items.cn: 拉丁语把这个词借作 aer，在散文与诗歌中都用来指空气与大气。

items.en: Old French air added the sense of appearance or manner, a meaning already visible in courtly writing.
items.cn: 古法语 air 增加了「外表、神态」的意思，这一含义在宫廷文学中已经可见。

items.en: English borrowed air in the thirteenth century and kept both the physical and the manner senses.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪借入 air，并同时保留了物理义与神态义。

items.en: Radio and television gave air the broadcast sense, while aviation gave it air travel and aircraft.
items.cn: 广播与电视给了 air「播送」的义项，航空则带来 air travel 与 aircraft 等说法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers adjectives and forms built on air; the near-meaning group gathers words for the surrounding medium and the sky.
note.cn: 形近组收由 air 构成的形容词与形式；近义组收表示周围介质与天空的词。

entries.definition: Full of air, light in movement, or lacking substance.
entries.definitionCN: 充满空气的、轻盈的，或缺乏实质内容的。

entries.definition: Having no fresh air or ventilation.
entries.definitionCN: 没有新鲜空气或不通风的。

entries.definition: The act of exposing something to air, or a short broadcast.
entries.definitionCN: 晾晒、通风的动作，或一次短暂的播送。

entries.definition: The layer of gases around a planet, or the mood of a place.
entries.definitionCN: 行星周围的气体层，或一个地方的氛围。

entries.definition: A gentle wind that moves through the air.
entries.definitionCN: 在空气中流动的微风。

entries.definition: The space above the earth that we see when we look upward.
entries.definitionCN: 抬头所见的地面上方的空间。

normalIntro.en: Air is invisible, so these hooks tie it to breath, balloons, and broadcasts that make it visible.
normalIntro.cn: air 看不见，所以下面这些钩子把它系到呼吸、气球与播送上，让它可以被看见。

normal.en: Air is what you take in without noticing: every breath is a quiet reminder.
normal.cn: air 是你不知不觉就吸进去的东西：每一次呼吸都是安静的提醒。

normal.en: A balloon rising is air made visible as a shape.
normal.cn: 上升的气球就是被塑成形状、变得可见的空气。

normal.en: Fresh air, air travel, air pollution: the phrase family keeps the element close.
normal.cn: fresh air、air travel、air pollution：这一串短语让这种元素始终在身边。

normal.en: An air of confidence is a mood worn like a coat.
normal.cn: an air of confidence 是像外套一样披在身上的气氛。

normal.en: Radio shows air, because sound needs air to travel.
normal.cn: 广播节目会 air，因为声音需要空气才能传播。

abstract.en: Air is presence without shape: the clearest example of something real yet invisible.
abstract.cn: air 是没有形状的存在：真实却不可见，它是最清楚的例子。

abstract.en: The word moves from the thing itself to the space it fills, and then to the impression it carries.
abstract.cn: 这个词从物质本身，走到它所充满的空间，再走到它所承载的印象。

abstract.en: Air is shared by everyone, which is why pollution and fresh air are public words.
abstract.cn: 空气为所有人共享，所以 pollution 与 fresh air 都成了公共话题。

examples.en: The room needs fresh air.
examples.cn: 这个房间需要新鲜空气。

examples.en: Her air of calm reassured the crowd.
examples.cn: 她那镇定神态让人群安下心来。

examples.en: The show will air next Monday.
examples.cn: 这个节目下周一播出。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「爱儿」：婴儿出生后第一口吸进的就是 air。

root: 经古法语 air 来自拉丁语 aer，更早来自希腊语 aēr（雾气、下层大气）；本义是「看不见的雾气」。

sensesIntro.en: Air covers the gas we breathe, the space above us, the impression a person gives, the act of broadcasting, and the act of drying in the open.
sensesIntro.cn: air 覆盖我们呼吸的气体、头顶的空间、一个人给人的印象、播送的动作，以及在户外晾晒的动作。

core.en: An invisible medium that holds breath, flight, and sound.
core.cn: 一种看不见的介质，托住呼吸、飞行与声音。

branches.en: The gas itself, the base of every other sense.
branches.cn: 气体本身，是其余义项的基础。

branches.en: The space the gas fills, where things fly and hang.
branches.cn: 气体所充满的空间，事物在其中飞行与悬停。

branches.en: The impression that surrounds a person like atmosphere.
branches.cn: 像气氛一样环绕一个人的印象。

branches.en: Sound and pictures sent through the air as broadcast.
branches.cn: 通过空气发送声音与画面的播送。

branches.en: Air used as a tool for drying and freshening.
branches.cn: 把空气当作晾干与换气的工具。

intro.en: Air is a free stem that forms adjectives with -y and -less and compounds with almost any noun.
intro.cn: air 是自由词干，能用 -y 与 -less 构成形容词，也能与几乎所有名词组成复合词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin layer is aer, air, with the adjective aerius, of the air.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语层是 aer（空气），其形容词 aerius 表示「空气的」。

items.example: The air was cold and clean.
items.exampleCN: 空气又冷又干净。

items.meaningCN: 神态（复数）；（第三人称单数）播送
items.example: He put on airs at the party.
items.exampleCN: 他在聚会上摆起了架子。

items.example: The interview aired last night.
items.exampleCN: 采访昨晚播出了。

items.example: The airing of the debate drew a crowd.
items.exampleCN: 这场辩论的播出吸引了不少人。

items.example: The airy studio felt open and bright.
items.exampleCN: 这间通风的工作室显得开阔明亮。

items.example: The airless cellar smelled of damp.
items.exampleCN: 不通风的地窖里有股潮气。

items.example: The airiness of the hall surprised visitors.
items.exampleCN: 大厅的通透让来访者惊讶。

items.example: Open the window and let in fresh air.
items.exampleCN: 打开窗户，让新鲜空气进来。

items.example: Air travel grew quickly after the war.
items.exampleCN: 战后航空旅行迅速发展。

latinEntries.example: The Latin poet spoke of aer as the breath of the world.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语诗人把 aer 说成世界的气息。

latinEntries.meaning: of the air, high in the air
latinEntries.example: An aerius path carried the birds over the valley.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 一条空中的路径让鸟群飞过山谷。

definition_zh: 飞机；航空器；飞行器
definition_en: any vehicle designed to travel through the air, such as an airplane, helicopter, or balloon
core_image: 离开地面、靠机翼与动力留在空中的载具
scene: 跑道上，地勤人员挥手示意放行，引擎声越来越响。The aircraft lifted off the runway and turned toward the sea.
sceneCN: 这里 aircraft 是「航空器、飞机」（第 1 个义项：能在空中飞行的载具）；句意为这架飞机离开跑道，转向海面。

pos.zh: 名词：飞机；航空器；飞行器

derivatives.zh: 由 aircraft 与 carrier 复合而成，义为「航空母舰」
由 aircraft 与 man 复合而成，义为「航空兵；空军士兵」

senses.title: A vehicle that flies
senses.definition: a machine or vehicle designed to travel through the air, including planes, helicopters, and balloons
senses.definitionCN: 设计用于在空中飞行的机器或载具，包括飞机、直升机与气球
senses.example: The aircraft landed safely despite the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管有暴风雨，这架飞机还是安全着陆了。
senses.why: The compound joins the medium to the vessel: a craft made to work in the air.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词把介质与载具连在一起：为在空中工作而造的船。

senses.title: Flying vehicles as a category
senses.definition: the whole class of flying machines, considered collectively rather than one by one
senses.definitionCN: 所有飞行机器的整体类别，而不是逐架看待
senses.example: Modern aircraft rely on lightweight composite materials.
senses.exampleCN: 现代航空器依赖轻质复合材料。
senses.why: A collective noun lets engineers and regulators speak about the category without naming every type.
senses.whyCN: 集合名词让工程师与监管者不必逐一列举型号，就能谈论整个类别。

senses.title: A military force of flying machines
senses.definition: planes and helicopters regarded as a combat force or unit
senses.definitionCN: 被视为作战力量或单位的飞机与直升机
senses.example: The base keeps a squadron of aircraft ready.
senses.exampleCN: 基地让一个中队的航空器保持待命。
senses.why: In military usage the machine becomes a unit, counted and deployed like ships or tanks.
senses.whyCN: 在军事用法中，机器变成一个单位，像舰船或坦克那样被计数与部署。

intro.en: Aircraft is a modern compound of two old words, air from Greek and craft from Old English.
intro.cn: aircraft 是两个古老词组成的现代复合词：air 来自希腊语，craft 来自古英语。

items.en: The first element traces to Latin aer and Greek aēr, the misty lower atmosphere.
items.cn: 第一个成分可追溯到拉丁语 aer 与希腊语 aēr，指雾气般的下层大气。

items.en: Craft comes from Old English craeft, meaning strength, skill, or a vessel, and it still names skilled work.
items.cn: craft 来自古英语 craeft，意为「力量、技艺、船只」，至今仍指需要技艺的工作。

items.en: The compound aircraft appeared in the age of balloons and early flying machines, before powered flight was common.
items.cn: 复合词 aircraft 出现在气球与早期飞行器的时代，那时动力飞行还不普遍。

items.en: With powered flight the word narrowed toward airplanes and helicopters, and aviation became an industry.
items.cn: 随着动力飞行的发展，这个词收窄到飞机与直升机，航空也成为一门产业。

items.en: Modern compounds such as aircraft carrier and aircraftman extend the word from the machine to the institution around it.
items.cn: aircraft carrier 与 aircraftman 等现代复合词把这个词从机器扩展到围绕它的制度。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers compounds sharing the craft element; the near-meaning group gathers specific kinds of flying machines.
note.cn: 形近组收共享 craft 成分的复合词；近义组收具体的飞行器种类。

entries.definition: A large warship that serves as a floating base for aircraft.
entries.definitionCN: 作为航空器海上基地的大型军舰。

entries.definition: A low-ranking member of an air force, formed from aircraft plus man.
entries.definitionCN: 由 aircraft 加 man 构成，指空军中军衔较低的成员。

entries.definition: A vehicle that rides on a cushion of air, sharing the craft element.
entries.definitionCN: 靠气垫行驶的载具，与 aircraft 共享 craft 这一成分。

entries.definition: A fixed-wing flying vehicle driven by an engine.
entries.definitionCN: 由发动机驱动的固定翼飞行载具。

entries.definition: The British spelling of airplane, used for the same fixed-wing machine.
entries.definitionCN: airplane 的英式拼写，指同一种固定翼飞机。

entries.definition: A flying vehicle lifted and steered by rotating blades.
entries.definitionCN: 靠旋转叶片升空与操控的飞行载具。

normalIntro.en: Aircraft is a transparent compound, and these hooks keep the two halves visible.
normalIntro.cn: aircraft 是个意思透明的复合词；下面这些钩子让两个成分始终清晰可见。

normal.en: Air plus craft: the air is the medium, and the craft is the skilled vessel.
normal.cn: air 加 craft：air 是介质，craft 是需要技艺的载具。

normal.en: Craft also means a boat, so an aircraft is a boat for the air.
normal.cn: craft 也能指船，所以 aircraft 就是一艘在空中航行的船。

normal.en: Aircraft keeps the same form in the plural, like sheep and deer.
normal.cn: aircraft 的复数形式不变，和 sheep、deer 一样。

normal.en: An aircraft carrier is a ship that carries aircraft, which makes the compound easy to unpack.
normal.cn: aircraft carrier 是运载航空器的船，这个复合词因此很容易拆解。

normal.en: Every aircraft begins with the same three letters as the air it flies through.
normal.cn: 每个 aircraft 都以它穿行其间的 air 那三个字母开头。

abstract.en: Aircraft is a name for the human attempt to make the air into a road.
abstract.cn: aircraft 是人类把天空变成道路的尝试所得到的名字。

abstract.en: The word combines a natural element with a human skill, and the machine is the meeting point.
abstract.cn: 这个词把自然元素与人类技艺组合起来，机器就是两者的交会点。

abstract.en: Craft carries the idea of controlled skill, which is why the word suits vehicles that must be piloted.
abstract.cn: craft 带着「受控技艺」的意思，因此这个词适合必须被人操控的载具。

examples.en: The aircraft landed safely despite the storm.
examples.cn: 尽管有暴风雨，这架飞机还是安全着陆了。

examples.en: Rescue aircraft circled the flooded valley.
examples.cn: 救援飞机在洪水淹没的山谷上空盘旋。

examples.en: Modern aircraft can fly through the night.
examples.cn: 现代航空器能够在夜间飞行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「埃尔克拉夫特」：air 与 craft 连读，就是能飞上天的航空器。

root: 由 air（空气）与 craft（技艺、船只、飞行器）复合而成；craft 源自古英语 cræft（力量、技艺），二十世纪起专指飞行载具。

sensesIntro.en: Aircraft names one flying vehicle, the whole class of flying machines, and a military force made of them.
sensesIntro.cn: aircraft 可指一架飞行载具、整个飞行机器类别，也可指由它们组成的军事力量。

core.en: A crafted vessel that leaves the ground and stays in the air.
core.cn: 一艘经过打造的载具，离开地面并留在空中。

branches.en: One machine that flies, taken as a single object.
branches.cn: 作为单个物体看待的一架飞行机器。

branches.en: The category of all flying machines, spoken of collectively.
branches.cn: 把所有飞行机器作为一个类别来谈。

branches.en: Flying machines organized as a military force.
branches.cn: 被组织成军事力量的飞行机器。

branches.en: Both senses count machines, one by one or as a unit.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在清点机器，或逐架或按单位。

branches.en: Both senses treat aircraft as a body rather than a single craft.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把 aircraft 当作一个整体，而不是单独一架。

intro.en: Aircraft is a compound stem that builds titles, roles, and compound nouns without changing shape.
intro.cn: aircraft 是复合词干，能在不改变形态的情况下构成头衔、角色与复合名词。

latinIntro.en: Only the air half is Latin, from aer; the craft half is Old English and supplies the skilled-vessel idea.
latinIntro.cn: 只有 air 这一半来自拉丁语 aer；craft 这一半来自古英语，提供「技艺载具」的意思。

items.example: The aircraft waited at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 飞机在登机口等待。

items.example: An aircraftman checked the runway lights.
items.exampleCN: 一名航空兵检查了跑道灯。

items.meaning: a female air-force member of low rank
items.example: The aircraftwoman joined the ground crew.
items.exampleCN: 这名女航空兵加入了地勤组。

items.example: The aircraft carrier anchored offshore.
items.exampleCN: 航空母舰在近海抛锚。

items.example: Military aircraft patrolled the border.
items.exampleCN: 军用航空器在边境巡逻。

items.example: Civil aircraft share the same airspace.
items.exampleCN: 民用航空器共享同一片空域。

items.meaning: an aircraft without a pilot on board
items.example: The unmanned aircraft mapped the coast.
items.exampleCN: 无人驾驶航空器测绘了海岸线。

items.meaning: an engine built for a flying vehicle
items.example: The aircraft engine was tested on the ground.
items.exampleCN: 航空发动机在地面进行了测试。

latinEntries.example: Aer is the Latin word behind the first half of aircraft.
latinEntries.exampleCN: aer 是 aircraft 前半部分背后的拉丁语词。
